# Context before the first check

This is an informed #82 naming-migration study under the active 111-Issue plan.
The reviewer has read actual Issue #82, the before-code ordinary naming decision
[#82 comment6009162442](https://github.com/MGYamada/Qleisli/issues/82#issuecomment-6009162442),
the existing common static parser/Bind checker, finite static-operation/provider
gate, selected projection, operation-parameter tests, and the authoring-session
procedure. There is prior repository/Issue/code context; this is not a blind
model benchmark. Exact deployed model identifier/sampling settings were unavailable.

The new name is `checked_op(implementation, Meaning)`, with two existing
declaration identifiers and existing StaticOpKind::Bind. No constructed or
specialized provider argument is added. The common MeaningEquality obligation
stays pending; the finite retained-source/kernel gate supplies actual acceptance,
and selected concrete Bind construction remains separately unsupported.
The name does not confer constitutional certification or inverse/control access.

Two separately named exact Z providers, a phase/reference/control interference
client, the XZX=-Z counterexample, a same-width/different-tree case, runtime/quantum
and formal-provider captures, consumed-owner reuse, and nested existing constructors
are saved as eight desired/legacy pairs. All complete schema-2 manifests specify
constitutional edition 2026; no source uses more than three declared/prepared
quantum bits. Desired and legacy sources differ only in the constructor spelling.
Their source bytes, expectations and pending inventory precede all CLI commands.
